text:
My first 2 GrokBot @bot templates are live!

1. Announcr Voice
 https://x.ai/bot/h-Vxewn8CGFLx6qrzNUJJ
Hear updates from your GrokBots out loud, over your speakers, no matter what screen you’re on. Hub bot for spoken alerts via Announcr (Notes, reminders, multi-card CTAs). 

2. LinkedIn Watch
 https://x.ai/bot/qbBlMjsKq-1coFvbmnEaR
Proactive LinkedIn digest bot — feed, DMs, invites, views, and jobs on a schedule, linked digests in chat. Optionally speaks multi-card Announcr updates with CTAs (Announcr is optional; chat still works alone).
